record.summary: Imran Sheikh, a 22‑year‑old college student, was charged with causing hurt and minor property damage after an altercation outside a café on a Saturday night. Deepak Rawat alleges Imran punched him and broke his phone. CCTV shows Deepak pushing first, Imran pushing back, and no clear view of the phone. Imran was arrested, released on bail, and gave an interview without a lawyer. He seeks advice on the strength of the case, self‑defence claim, plea options, and dealing with police.
record.goal: Assess legal options and strategy regarding the charges of causing hurt and property damage, including the viability of a self‑defence claim, whether to accept a plea or settlement, and how to handle further police contact.
record.location: Location not specified; to be confirmed.

contradictions: Deepak states the incident occurred at 10:40 pm, but CCTV shows it began at 10:52 pm.
Deepak's friend claims Imran attacked without warning, whereas CCTV shows Deepak pushing Imran first.
Deepak alleges Imran smashed his phone, but the phone was not visible in the CCTV footage and a prior photo shows a pre‑existing crack.
Imran says he only pushed back in self‑defence and never touched the phone, yet his police interview includes a statement that he "hit him back".
evidence: Charge sheet includes Deepak's statement, a medical report noting a 1 cm lip laceration, and photos of the broken phone.
CCTV footage shows the altercation beginning at 10:52 pm, Deepak pushing first, Imran pushing back, and Deepak falling; phone not visible at the moment of alleged smashing.
Photo posted online by Deepak two weeks earlier shows a pre‑existing crack in the phone screen.
Café waiter testimony that both men were shouting but did not see who struck first.
